team_state.purpose: replace fixed half-life/Hedge adaptation with stable-vs-break Bayesian borrowing
required_frozen_inputs: current PIT observation mean and variance

direct_total_goals.purpose: predict P(T=0..7+) through shot quantity x shot quality rather than a single expected-goals mean

team_process.match_total: convolution of home and away goal marginals into 0..7+

forbidden_fallbacks: league-wide dispersion substituted for missing team dispersion

conditional_exact_score.purpose: allocate score probability conditional on the independent total-goals track with flexible home-away dependence

structure.prior: Sarmanov joint from home and away goal marginals
structure.dependence_parameter: rho supplied by a PIT/OOS estimator
structure.total_constraint: exact diagonal projection to independent P(T=0..7+)

forbidden_fallbacks: score model overwriting the direct total track

future_optional_market_constraints.correct_score_market: may constrain observed score cells only after a separately frozen, timestamped and price-complete market contract exists
future_optional_market_constraints.multi_line_totals: may project the direct total prior only from observed synchronized market constraints

note: Architecture edited only. No compile, replay, backtest, forward prediction, metric calculation or promotion decision is part of this change.
